title: Nutritional Requirements throughout the Life Cycle
abstract: The document states that "Although diets that are modest in protein have been associated with health benefits, including reductions in diabetes and cancer incidence and overall mortality for people aged 65 and under, for those over aged 65, it remains important to ensure adequate protein intake for older people." This aligns with the user's query about low protein intake and its association with mortality and cancer, specifically noting the age-related difference.
